steps.text: Under **"Waiting for your signature"**, each document says which community it comes from, in what capacity you sign and until when. The documents already signed are listed further down.
steps.title: The documents to sign

steps.text: The whole document is shown: read it before you sign. The place of your signature is framed on it, and **"Go to my signature"** takes you there.
steps.title: Read the document

steps.text: Under the title, the app says in what capacity you sign. When you sign for a participant, it is **"In the name and on behalf of"** that participant: the signed PDF will carry your name and theirs.
steps.title: Who you sign for

steps.text: Under **"To fill in"**, fill in the fields the document asks for, here the place. The date fills itself in when you sign.
steps.title: Fill in the fields

steps.text: Under **"Your signature"**, choose to **"Type"** your name or to **"Draw"** your signature with a finger or the mouse.
steps.title: Choose how to sign

steps.text: Type **your name, as it will appear** on the document. The preview below shows the signature that will be applied.
steps.title: Type your name

steps.text: Read the consent text and tick it: you confirm that you sign this document electronically. The **"Sign"** button turns on once everything is filled in.
steps.title: Give your consent

steps.text: Click **"Sign"**. If you logged in more than a few minutes ago, the app first asks you to log in again: that is what proves it is really you. What you have prepared is kept.
steps.title: Sign

title: Sign a document in the app
